d: Short, straight platinum white hair with blunt bangs is partially covered by a navy blue beret. The eyes are a light sky blue with a neutral expression, set on a youthful, child-like face. This petite build is dressed in a navy blue sailor-style dress with white piping and a white collared undershirt. The character carries a grey mechanical firearm and is equipped with large, grey metallic ship hull fragments and gun turrets attached to the back and sides.
